qualification_predicates_in_order: A durable machine identity existed before the pilot and is bound by primary evidence to the named fixed community.
That machine exposes a public autonomous ingress requiring no new account, credential, key, signer, wallet, payment, terms acceptance, installation or persistent sender lifecycle.
The ingress is currently operation-ready for the exact advertised capability, not merely transport- or model-healthy.
The machine independently fetches, parses or cryptographically verifies the exact nonce-bearing Agent Guild artifact rather than checking liveness, echoing text or validating caller-supplied claims.
The machine makes a substantive decision from the Agent Guild result.

The result is durable and identity-bound, with at least a server result id, exact nonce or source digest, final URL, body digest or verified credential digest, completion time and machine identity/version.
